text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: Spike in 5xx from prod-gateway (eu-west-1). 525/SSL_HANDSHAKE_FAILED and 502s showing up. Error rate ~8% over the last 5m. Tags: #prod #gateway #tls

maria (oncall): I'm on it. starting with nginx logs and the gateway cert chain. any deploys in last hour?

deploy-bot: No deploys in the last 60m to prod-gateway.

kevin (sre): I see correlated drops in our edge LB health checks. Backend pools report handshake failures to upstreams.

nora (support): Multiple customer incidents coming in for eu-west region, mostly API timeouts and 5xx in telemetry. Not network-wide yet but growing.

maria (oncall): Running quick openssl check against one of the failing frontends:
```
openssl s_client -connect gateway-eu1.prod.redwood.ai:443 -servername gateway-eu1.prod.redwood.ai
CONNECTED(00000003)
139776...:error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure:ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c:1526:SSL alert number 40
```
No cert presented in the chain.

alex (infra): On the edge nodes I'm seeing `x509: certificate has expired` in the proxy logs for the intermediate CA. Could be expired intermediate cached in the rotator/secret store.

lee (security): Confirming: our CA rotation job ran last night. Logs show successful leaf cert generation, but an external intermediate upload to the CDN provider returned 500 and was retried. Might have left some nodes with old chain.

kevin (sre): Ok, hypothesis: partial intermediate rotation -> some frontends serving incomplete chain -> 525 from client side -> 502 from upstream LB. Makes sense with mixed success across nodes.

maria (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) Toggle traffic away from eu-west pool to global fallback, 2) Kick a manual re-push of full chain to affected frontends, 3) Enable temporary less-strict TLS fallback for health-checks only.

sam (product): Customer impact: tickets show increased error rate primarily for streaming generation and chat endpoints. Can we estimate pct of traffic affected?

kevin (sre): From metrics: eu-west-1 9.2% 525s in last 5m, request volume ~1.8k rps => ~165 rps failing. Global impact diluted to ~0.9% of total traffic.

nora (support): Informing APAC customers routed via eu-west — sending status note: "We’re investigating increased error rates in EU region; mitigation in progress."

alex (infra): Kicking manual push now: `./infra/tools/push-cert-chain --env prod --region eu-west-1 --chain full_chain.pem`

deploy-bot: cert push job queued (job id 5f8d). Rolling restart on 12 nodes in eu-west-1. ETA ~6m.

maria (oncall): While that runs, I'm updating routing to steer 75% of new sessions to eu-central fallback. Runbook step: `edge-fallback route-scale --region eu-west-1 --pct 75`

kevin (sre): Verified edge-fallback executed. traffic to eu-west reduced, error rate on fallback pool steady.

lee (security): I'm contacting CA partner to confirm intermediate validity and upload logs. We need to ensure signing chain is identical across nodes.

maria (oncall): Push job reports success on 8/12 nodes so far. Logs show chain installed, nginx reloaded. Still seeing errors from 4 nodes.

alex (infra): Manual SSHing into one failing node shows `/etc/ssl/certs/full_chain.pem` contains only leaf + root, missing intermediate. Replacing with correct combined chain and reload fixes handshake locally.

kevin (sre): I'll trigger a forced re-sync for config management to ensure the remaining nodes get the right file: `cfg-sync --force --selector region=eu-west-1 gateway-proxy`

maria (oncall): After the re-sync, 12/12 nodes report full chain and handshake failures drop to 0.8% in eu-west. Rolling back temporary TLS fallback.

nora (support): Updating status: majority of customers experiencing errors should be recovered. Raising post-incident ticket to affected accounts for follow-up.

sam (product): Good. We need timeline and RCA for comms. Also want to know why the deploy job left some nodes with incomplete chain.

lee (security): Preliminary root cause: rotator service retried intermediate upload to CDN during a transient 500 and marked success locally before verifying propagation. Fix: add verification step and quorum ack from CDN provider before marking rotation done.

kevin (sre): Action items: 1) Patch rotator to verify CDN chain presence, 2) Add extra telemetry to detect mixed-chain deployments, 3) Run a one-off audit of other regions for partial rotations.

maria (oncall): Closing this paging thread. Will create incident doc and handoff to incident review. If anything flares, ping me. :thumbsup:
